+title: 'Model records: ThreadRecord, ThreadItem, Message, ContentBlock, ToolCallRecord (plan §3.2)'
+---
+## What
+Create the record types in `Sources/AgentViewKit/Model/`, per plan.md §3.2.
+
+- `ThreadRecord.swift`: `public protocol ThreadRecord: AnyObject, Identifiable, Observable` with `id: String`, `revision: Int`, `meta: JSONValue?`. Define a kit-local `JSONValue` enum (null, bool, number, string, array, object) so the core target has no ACP import.
+- `ThreadItem.swift`: `public enum ThreadItem` with cases `system(SystemPrompt)`, `userMessage(Message)`, `assistantMessage(Message)`, `reasoning(Reasoning)`, `toolCall(ToolCallRecord)`, `structured(StructuredRecord)`, `compaction(CompactionMarker)`, `error(ThreadError)`, `unknown(UnknownRecord)`. Add `var record: any ThreadRecord` and `var id: String`.
+- One `@Observable final class` per record, each with `id`, `revision`, `meta`, and a `bump()` that increments `revision`.
+- `ContentBlock.swift`: `text`, `image`, `audio`, `resourceLink(name, uri, icons, mimeType)`, `resource(text or blob)`, `attachment(URL)`, `structured(schemaName, payload)`, `unknown(kind, raw)`. Each block carries optional `Annotations` with `audience: [Audience]` and `priority: Double?`.
+- `ToolCallRecord`: `title`, `kind` (`read, edit, delete, move, search, execute, think, fetch, switchMode, other, unknown(String)`), `status` (`pending, inProgress, completed, failed, cancelled, lost, unknown(String)`), `content: [ToolContent]` (`block`, `diff(patch)`, `terminal(id)`), `locations`, `rawInput`, `rawOutput`, `startedAt`, `endedAt`.
+- The payload for `structured` is `GeneratedContent`-free in this target: store a `JSONValue`. The FoundationModels target converts.
+- Every enum has an `unknown` case.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Every record type conforms to `ThreadRecord` and is `@Observable`.
+- [ ] `ThreadItem.id` returns the record id for every case.
+- [ ] `ToolCallStatus(wireValue: "_lost")` gives `.lost`; any other unknown string gives `.unknown(String)`.
+- [ ] `ContentBlock.isVisible(to: .user)` returns false when `annotations.audience` excludes the user.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/ThreadItemTests.swift`: id passthrough for all nine cases; `bump()` increments revision by one.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/ToolCallStatusTests.swift`: wire-value mapping including `_lost` and an unknown value.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/ContentBlockTests.swift`: audience filter and priority sort.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #foundation #model
\ No newline at end of file
